g.text: Describe a task: Argo can create code, review vulnerabilities, make fixes and run tests inside
The code worker has no network, host files or credentials. /import copies a project into it; /diff
shows exported changes. The next task continues that workspace.
Try /agent-demo for a SQL injection repair with regression tests. /chat opens advisory discussion;
Updated normalize.py to rename the parameter from 'email' to 'value' in the normalize_email
function while maintaining existing functionality. Added a test case in tests/test_normalize.py to
verify that the function can be called with the keyword argument 'value'. All tests pass
2 files restored. Type the next task to continue, or /reset to start empty.
Ask Argo a question, or /help for commands…
